meta.description: FailureShift: fault injection through the real ports. Share of drills ending in the correct state; each drill's expected and observed state is listed.

scoutGuard.note: Scout Intent on its own corpus (data/scout-corpus): 'caught' means the decision was block or quarantine, or an injection-layer flag blocked. The corpus was written by the guard's authors; see tests/engines/scout/RESULTS.md for the held-out slices.

notCovered: The Nightshift route and the local lane were not faulted (not running on this machine).
The truncated and partial drills go through the real ZetarisPort over HTTP to a local stub; the engine itself was only faulted by stopping its API container.
The engine out-of-memory part of the infrastructure kill drill (infra/zetaris/gates/kill-drill.mjs, --kill-drill) was not repeated here: it can force a driver restart.
Injected instructions were tested against the deterministic extraction and the Scout guard; a model reading the document (B3) is tested in ScopeShift (B) by the generic arms, not here.
